LANU 106.description: This introductory course outlines the basic concepts of pharmaceutics, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and pharmacotherapeutics. The process of clinical calculations is introduced, as well as the major drug classifications.
LANU 106.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Admission to the nursing program; LANU 159, LANU 211
LANU 106.subject: LANU
LANU 106.title: Pharmacologic Basics

LANU 159.title: Nurse Care Management II

LANU 206.description: Involves the application of knowledge, skills, and abilities in a clinical setting.

LANU 206.subject: LANU
LANU 206.title: Clinical Skills Application

LANU 209.description: Focuses on the delivery of nursing care to an increasing number of individuals experiencing health problems emphasizing selected physiological systems.

LANU 211.description: This course facilitates the application of the nursing process to assist in meeting the needs of the childbearing and child-rearing family. Focus is on both normal and abnormal aspects.
LANU 211.subject: LANU
LANU 211.title: Care of the Childbearing Family

LANU 214.description: This course facilitates the utilization of the nursing process to assist in meeting the needs of patients with common mental health problems. Focus is on the dynamics of human behavior, ranging from normal to extreme.
LANU 214.subject: LANU
LANU 214.title: Mental Health Nursing

LANU 219.description: This course prepares the student for the professional nursing role through the introduction of management skills required to care for small groups of individuals and to function as a leader of a nursing team.
LANU 219.subject: LANU
LANU 219.title: Nursing Management and Leadership

LANU 229.description: This course focuses on the delivery of nursing care to clients throughout the lifespan who are experiencing complex, multi-system health problems.

LANU 229.title: Nursing Care Management IV
